market_definition: The conductive foam market comprises foams treated or filled to shield against electromagnetic interference or dissipate static electricity. It measures sales of conductive and anti-static foam sheets, gaskets and packaging inserts. BY FUNCTION: EMI Shielding, ESD Protection. BY CONDUCTIVE TREATMENT: Metal-Plated Fabric Over Foam, Carbon-Loaded, Metal-Particle-Loaded. BY PRODUCT FORM: Gaskets, Sheets, Packaging Inserts. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Consumer Electronics, Automotive Electronics & EV Batteries, Industrial & Power Electronics, Telecom & Data Centers, Medical Devices, Aerospace & Defense, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Non-conductive foams; conductive adhesives and tapes; EMI shielding enclosures, paints and metal gaskets. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR / CONVERTER: a distributor, stockist or foam converter / fabricator that buys this foam from its makers and sells it (as supplied, or cut, laminated or shaped) to industry. EXCLUDED companies: foam and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
